page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with four lines of Arabic verse set below it, centred. Running head at the top, page number at the top right.

main_text.p: Syri, qui contra Eutychianos, Dio-scorianos, & Acephalos Conciliorum defensitarunt Decreta, & fidem acci-tam, quemadmodum plane constat ex Epistola Archimandritarum Syriae se-cundae ad Hormisdam Papam, libel-lo Monachorum Tractus Apameensis ad Syriae secundae Episcopos & aliis: Epistolae primo loco subscribit Ale-xander hisce verbis. Alexander Pres-byter, & Archimandrita Monasterii S. Maronis. Rem istam paucis com-plectitur titulus Dissertationum ejuf-dem Joannis Maronis in haec verba,
اعتقاد البيعة الرسولية الذي كتبه القديس يوحنا بطريرك انطاكية في بير مارون علي نهر العاصي بلل[?] حماد وحمص واوردا ذلك الي جبل لبنان ولاجل هذ[?]

page.notes: The Arabic verse is four lines; the last word of the final line is cut off at the edge of the print, so it is read as "هذ[?]". The word "بلل[?]" in the fourth line is doubtful. The Arabic letters are copied as they appear and may contain printing errors. Long s is read as plain s throughout. The opening fragment "Syri" continues the sentence from the previous page.
